sloka: शार्दूलस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।उवाच सहसा व्यग्रः सम्प्रधार्यार्थमात्मनः ॥६-२०-८॥।।
transliteration: śārdūlasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।uvāca sahasā vyagraḥ sampradhāryārthamātmanaḥ ॥6-20-8॥।।

translations.english: Ravana the tiger among Rakshasas, after having heard Shardula's words decided within himself and said to Suka who is good at work praising him very much as usual.
